collection.description: A villager's experiment fills the whole village with an enormous smell: own up, or quietly open the windows.

setup.name: The setup
setup.text: (subject) has been heating a mix of seaweed, fish oil and three kinds of root, to see what happens. What happens is the smell. It's not a bad smell, exactly. It's an enormous one. It rolls out of the laboratory and across the whole village, and people are starting to come out of their huts, sniffing the air.

a.name: Answer A
a.text: "It's me!" calls (subject), waving from the doorway. "It's science!" The villagers look at (subject.him/her). One of them, (neighbor), asks, holding (neighbor.his/her) nose, what it's for. "I don't know yet," says (subject), honestly. "That's what I'm finding out." Most of them go back inside. (child), a curious child, stays to watch.

b.name: Answer B
b.text: (subject) opens every opening in the laboratory and fans the air very hard with a big leaf. The smell drifts off over the sea, where several seabirds change direction to avoid it. By evening it's mostly gone. Nobody ever finds out where it came from. (subject) writes it all down anyway, with a note: DO NOT HEAT THIS AGAIN INDOORS.
